name: Dual-Axis Analog Joystick Module
description: Like a gaming controller thumbstick! Contains two potentiometers (X and Y) and a tactile push button.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a gaming controller thumbstick! Contains two potentiometers (X and Y) and a tactile push button.
wiringGuidance: Connect GND (Dark Slate) to GND, +5V (Red) to 5V, VRx (Yellow) to A0, VRy (Yellow) to A1, and SW (Green) to digital pin 2.
commonMistakes: Leaving the switch pin SW floating without INPUT_PULLUP.
Expecting exact 512 center values without accounting for mechanical potentiometer tolerances.

miniExperiment.title: Arcade Joystick Coordinates
miniExperiment.circuit: GND to GND, 5V to 5V, VRx to A0, VRy to A1, SW to Pin 2.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor streams live 2-axis stick coordinates and button click states.
